When to use: Request received and details to be reviewed
Replacement reply: Thank you for contacting us. We have received your request and will review the details.

When to use: Request details to be checked against records
Replacement reply: Thank you for your message. We will check the details of your request against our records.

When to use: Saved request not appearing in the list reproduced and cause still under investigation
Replacement reply: We reproduced the issue where a saved request does not appear in the list. We are still investigating the cause.

When to use: Development team has been asked about the reported issue
Replacement reply: We have asked our development team about the issue you reported. We will share what we learn.

When to use: One request seen after reopening the list; customer display still to be checked
Replacement reply: We opened the list again and were able to see one request. Could you check whether it appears on your screen as well?

When to use: Reference number needed to check the records
Replacement reply: Please send us the reference number so that we can check it against our records.

When to use: Sending owner and date and time accepted; contact even if the development answer is still pending
Replacement reply: We will contact you by [agreed date and time, JST] to share what we have confirmed and what is still open.
